2: expr ($counter = 0)
3: func tick()
  3: block
    4: global [$counter] 
    5: expr ($counter++)
    6: expr echo(`tick ${$counter}
`)
    7: return $counter
9: func main()
  9: block
    10: global [$counter] 
    11: expr ($arr = array[0, 0, 0, 0, 0])
    12: expr ($n = 0)
    13: expr ($arr[($n++)] = 7)
    14: expr ($arr[($n++)] = 8)
    15: expr ($i = 0)
    16: while ((($i++) + 0) < 3)
      16: block
        17: expr echo(`loop ${$i}
`)
    19: if ((tick() + 0) > 5)
      19: block
        20: expr echo("big\n")
    22: expr ($total = 0)
    23: expr ($total += tick())
    24: expr ($t = (($n > 1) ? ($n++) : 0))
    25: expr ($st = array[1, 2, 3, 4])
    26: while (count($st) && (array_pop($st) > 2))
      26: block
        27: expr echo("popped\n")
    29: expr ($k = 0)
    30: for [expr ($j = 0)] [(($j < 3) && (($k++) < 5))] [($j++)]
      30: block
        31: expr echo(`for ${$j} ${$k}
`)
    33: expr echo($arr[0], " ", $arr[1], " ", $n, " ", $i, " ", $counter, " ", $total, " ", $t, " ", count($st), " ", $k, "\n")
35: expr main()
